title: 8th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/2/2025).
Preliminary debate on the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad to amend Law No. 8/2025 (Attorney General's Office Act).

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal to gauge members' views on the rules for paying education-sector and health-sector workers for overtime work and on establishing a fair working environment.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Ihavandhoo MP Ahmed Naseer to amend Law No. 4/2012 (Thalassaemia Control Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened the preliminary debate on amending the Attorney General's Office Act and continued debating the overtime-pay resolution for teachers and health workers and the Thalassaemia Control Act amendment.
